Its actually pointless to train young players unless you have a certain pertinent stat you need to improve. Let me break it down. Each player grows naturally between 2-6 points in ALL their technical stats until they get close to their ultimate potential. Once they reach their potential they only grow in their position specific stats. Ie finishing and shooting stats for strikers, defensive stats for defenders. So by training you are actually making your players reach their overall sooner which is preventing them from getting the maximum possible growth in the rest of their stats. I only train players when they start nearing their actually potential or have stopped growing in all their stats. Might seem confusing but ive done extensive testing and it makes sense.
